name: ism-design-system
description: ISM Design System: the source of truth for ISM websites, apps and digital products (web, React, Next.js, React Native, iOS, Android).

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:icons && npm run build --workspace @ism/web && npm run build:specs && npm run sync:native && npm run build:previews && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:icons && npm run check:native && npm run check:specs && npm run validate
